name: Advanced Petrochemical Company
summary: Advanced Petrochemical Company, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and globally distributes a core portfolio of petrochemicals including propylene, polypropylene, and isopropyl alcohol. The company also produces polysilicon and related downstream products like photovoltaic cells. Its offerings further encompass various polypropylene types such as homopolymers, high crystalline resins, and both random and block copolymers. Additionally, the firm is involved in establishing, operating, and investing in diverse industrial projects, spanning petrochemicals, chemicals, foundational and conversion industries, and renewable energy. Its critical materials are utilized across numerous sectors, contributing to products like personal care items, fresh food packaging, lightweight plastics, construction materials, automotive components, durable textiles, and medical devices. Advanced Petrochemical Company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
